title: Overall ACS by Strategy
description: Mean ACS across all scenarios and frames for each strategy.
interpretation: Oracle achieves highest ACS (0.444). AI Adaptive (0.434) closely matches Fixed OTFS (0.435) and exceeds Fixed ODDM (0.390).

title: Overall BER by Strategy
description: Mean BER across all scenarios and frames for each strategy.
interpretation: Oracle (0.063) < Fixed OTFS (0.064) ≈ AI Adaptive (0.065) < Fixed ODDM (0.084). AI Adaptive BER close to best fixed strategy.

title: Overall Throughput by Strategy
description: Mean throughput in kbps across all scenarios and frames.
interpretation: Oracle (272 kbps) > AI Adaptive (263 kbps) > Fixed OTFS (260 kbps) > Fixed ODDM (242 kbps).

title: Overall CQI by Strategy
description: Mean CQI across all scenarios and frames.
interpretation: All strategies show similar CQI (10-10.3), indicating the channel quality is a property of the scenario, not the strategy.

title: Overall Spectral Efficiency by Strategy
description: Mean spectral efficiency for each strategy.
interpretation: Oracle leads; AI Adaptive and Fixed OTFS comparable; Fixed ODDM lower.

title: Detector Execution Time by Strategy
description: Mean wall-clock detector computation time (not communication latency). Oracle runs both detectors.
interpretation: Oracle ~2x single-detector time. AI Adaptive and Fixed strategies similar detector times (~single waveform detector).

title: OTFS vs ODDM BER Distribution
description: Boxplot of BER values for OTFS vs ODDM waveform selections.
interpretation: OTFS shows lower median BER and tighter distribution than ODDM.

title: OTFS vs ODDM Throughput Distribution
description: Boxplot of throughput for OTFS vs ODDM selections.
interpretation: OTFS median throughput higher than ODDM across all frames.

title: OTFS vs ODDM ACS Distribution
description: Boxplot of ACS for OTFS vs ODDM selections.
interpretation: OTFS achieves higher median ACS than ODDM.

title: OTFS vs ODDM CQI Distribution
description: Boxplot of CQI for OTFS vs ODDM selections.
interpretation: CQI distributions similar since CQI depends on channel, not waveform.

title: Waveform Usage by AI Adaptive System
description: Distribution of OTFS vs ODDM selections by the AI adaptive system.
interpretation: AI selects OTFS ~70% and ODDM ~30% of frames. Distribution reflects the AI's learned policy, not a predetermined split.

title: AI Selected Waveform vs Oracle Waveform
description: Confusion matrix of AI waveform selection vs oracle recommendation.
interpretation: Diagonal = agreement. High diagonal values indicate strong AI-oracle alignment.

title: BER vs SNR by Strategy
description: Mean BER at each SNR level for all four strategies.
interpretation: BER decreases with SNR for all strategies. AI Adaptive tracks Fixed OTFS closely across SNR range.

title: Throughput vs SNR by Strategy
description: Mean throughput at each SNR level.
interpretation: Throughput increases with SNR. AI Adaptive tracks Fixed OTFS.

title: ACS vs SNR by Strategy
description: Mean ACS at each SNR level.
interpretation: ACS improves with SNR. AI Adaptive close to oracle across range.

title: CQI vs SNR by Strategy
description: Mean CQI at each SNR level.
interpretation: CQI increases with SNR. Nearly identical across strategies.

title: Spectral Efficiency vs SNR by Strategy
description: Mean spectral efficiency at each SNR level.
interpretation: SE improves with SNR. Oracle leads; AI close to Fixed OTFS.

title: BER vs Speed by Strategy
description: Mean BER at each speed bin (rounded to nearest 25 km/h).
interpretation: Higher speed generally increases BER. AI tracks Fixed OTFS.

title: ACS vs Speed by Strategy
description: Mean ACS at each speed bin.
interpretation: ACS degrades at higher speeds for all strategies.

title: Throughput vs Speed by Strategy
description: Mean throughput at each speed bin.
interpretation: Throughput decreases at higher speeds.

title: BER vs Doppler Frequency by Strategy
description: Mean BER at each Doppler frequency bin (rounded to nearest 10 Hz).
interpretation: Higher Doppler generally correlates with higher BER.

title: ACS vs Doppler Frequency by Strategy
description: Mean ACS at each Doppler frequency bin.
interpretation: ACS degrades with higher Doppler. AI tracks Fixed OTFS.

title: BER by Channel Profile
description: Mean BER for each channel profile across all strategies.
interpretation: ETU (most dispersive) generally shows highest BER. AI Adaptive tracks Fixed OTFS across all channels.

title: ACS by Channel Profile
description: Mean ACS for each channel profile across all strategies.
interpretation: EPA (least dispersive) shows highest ACS.

title: Throughput by Channel Profile
description: Mean throughput for each channel profile.
interpretation: EPA yields highest throughput; ETU lowest.

title: CQI by Channel Profile
description: Mean CQI for each channel profile.
interpretation: CQI relatively stable across channels since it is a channel property.

title: BER by Modulation
description: Mean BER for each modulation type across strategies.
interpretation: 64-QAM shows highest BER as expected (dense constellation). AI Adaptive tracks Fixed OTFS across all modulations.

title: Throughput by Modulation
description: Mean throughput for each modulation type.
interpretation: 64-QAM throughput lower due to high BER. QPSK most robust.

title: ACS by Modulation
description: Mean ACS for each modulation type.
interpretation: QPSK achieves highest ACS. 64-QAM lowest.

title: CQI by Modulation
description: Mean CQI for each modulation type.
interpretation: CQI similar across modulations since it is channel-dependent.

title: Predicted vs Actual BER
description: AI engine predicted BER vs actual measured BER for both waveforms.
interpretation: Scatter around y=x indicates prediction quality.

title: Predicted vs Actual Throughput
description: AI engine predicted throughput vs actual throughput.
interpretation: Clustering along y=x indicates good prediction.

title: Predicted vs Actual ACS
description: AI engine predicted ACS vs actual ACS.
interpretation: Scatter along y=x indicates prediction calibration.

title: AI-Oracle Decision Agreement by Environment
description: Oracle agreement rate by environment category.
interpretation: Pedestrian and UrbanFast show highest agreement. Urban (most dynamic) shows lower agreement where switching matters most.

title: AI Waveform Switching Timeline
description: Step plot of AI waveform selection over frames for scenarios with at least one switch.
interpretation: Red markers indicate switching points. Total 22 switches across all scenarios.

title: Scenario ACS Heatmap
description: Heatmap of mean ACS per scenario and strategy.
interpretation: Shows where adaptation helps (AI close to oracle) and where it does not.

title: Scenario BER Heatmap
description: Heatmap of mean BER per scenario and strategy.
interpretation: Lower BER is better. Shows where AI narrows the gap to oracle.

title: ACS and BER Regret Distribution
description: Distribution of regret (oracle metric minus AI-selected metric).
interpretation: Low mean regret indicates AI close to oracle. Tail values show worst-case suboptimal decisions.

title: AI vs Oracle ACS Gap by Environment
description: Oracle ACS vs AI Adaptive ACS for each environment.
interpretation: Smaller gap means AI closer to ideal. Urban environments show largest gap where switching decisions matter most.

title: Strategy Comparison Summary Table
description: Tabular comparison of key metrics across all strategies.
interpretation: Quick reference for overall strategy performance.

title: AI Adaptive ACS vs SNR by Environment
description: AI Adaptive ACS at each SNR level, broken down by environment.
interpretation: Different environments show different ACS-SNR profiles.

title: AI Prediction Confidence Distribution
description: Distribution of AI engine confidence scores.
interpretation: Low confidence values suggest the AI engine may benefit from calibration or richer features.
